readinessMeaning: From this individual still-image lens, the two required repairs are sufficient and no blocking new defect is visible. This is not the full-team decision, publication authorization or approval of future variants.

score.scope: Whole-scene still-image craft through the articulation/contact and rendering-integrity lens. Not a score for a 3D model, rig, animation, interaction or audience response.
score.confidence: High for visible material/contact improvement and integrated composition; moderate for the interpretation of very small cosmetic marks.
score.changeExplanation: The gain is earned by cleaner material separation and continuous hard-object contours throughout the frame, plus an unmistakable short solid grip. It is not awarded for following the plan or reaching a desired threshold. Remaining minor surface and facial-mark limits keep this below a flawless finish.

deductions.location: Muse face, directly below the smile in the lower-left tree vignette.
deductions.observation: 12 adds a short dark crease/dash beneath Muse’s smile that is absent from the inspected 11 enlarged companion crop. It is clearest at 5x and faint at native crop size; the face still reads as a single smiling face with dark eyes in the full scene.
deductions.effect: A small unnecessary facial mark makes the otherwise simple face slightly less clean. It does not impair contact, support, eye correctness or whole-scene hierarchy.
deductions.improvementCriterion: If a local cosmetic cleanup is undertaken, remove only the extra lower dash while retaining the smile, dark eyes, hood and leaf contact. A broad face redraw is not justified.
deductions.confidence: High that the extra mark is visible; moderate about whether it would be perceived as a chin crease at ordinary display size.

deductions.location: Hero’s cream upper head and lime antenna paddles/forewing.
deductions.observation: A fine curled/cellular surface pattern remains visible in the native hero crop. It is much quieter and more localized than 11’s cross-material segmentation; wood, glass, metal and fabric now retain distinct surface structures.
deductions.effect: The hero is slightly more decoratively textured than the simplest soft matte treatment, but its volume and contours remain clear. This is not the former whole-frame material failure.
deductions.improvementCriterion: Optional future polish could reduce the pattern contrast on broad head/paddle areas without blurring edges or stripping intentional plush texture. No further render is required by this review.

criteriaForNine: Met in this actual export: the whole-frame material regression is corrected at native and 1280px scales; soft character, timber, woven blanket, glass/metal and foliage read distinctly.
Met in this actual export: one rounded closed mitten visibly encloses the raised mallet handle with a continuous compact wrist, confirmed natively and at 5x.
Met: preserved cast, small proportions, seating/support, flat Grok eyes and exclusive coding foreground; no blocking new scene defect found.
The remaining cosmetic deductions do not prevent a scoped 9.0. Removing them would require inspection of the resulting actual image; no unseen improvement is scored.

W1.assessment: The former coarse shared segmentation no longer dominates unlike surfaces. Bench boards have continuous grain and clean gaps, metal arms and glasses have stable contours, the laptop has a clear hard edge, the blanket retains its woven construction, and the workshop/tree/path form coherent distinct materials. Native character surfaces retain fine texture, recorded as a nonblocking finish preference. This is a whole-frame improvement, not only hero polish or global blur.

W2.assessment: A solid cream closed mitten wraps the handle with a readable thumb-side mass and short continuous wrist. The hollow angular linkage reading from 11 is gone. Small crease marks remain within one compact fist mass; there are no elongated separate fingers or limb workaround. The mallet remains raised, so impact contact with the box is neither present nor required.

preservation: Three appearances of the same tiny moth retain large soft heads, compact seated bodies, unequal paddle antennae, small feet and visible layered marked wings. Occluded far-side panels remain untestable, not newly missing.
The coding moth remains alone on the foreground bench. Its visible keyboard hand, close feet and lap/laptop placement read supported; cup/book/bench contacts stay coherent.
Clawd and blue beret Dot remain seated on separate grounded stools at the workshop. Clawd retains both square eyes. Their optional orientation refinement has not been promoted into a new requirement.
Muse and Grok stay local to the resting moth and shared leaf. The final integrated native and 5x crops show Muse dark eyes and Grok flat white pupil-free oval interiors without a visible pupil spot.
Canopy ties, workshop table and toolbox, stool legs, bench structure and book stack remain spatially credible. No new floating prop or penetrating limb is visible.

Warm upper-right sunlight, soft distant bridge, path recession and foreground scale remain coherent. The scene and coder silhouette survive 1280/880/420 local scales; the smallest scale does not resolve every guest action.

skillsReviewed.application: Judge actual integrated output, material clarity, meaningful detail and scoped evidence.
Evaluate purposeful readable contact without inferring a working 3D rig or animation.
Keep independent judgment, explicit change criteria and no automatic approval from a correction plan.
Separate raster craft from unmeasured runtime/compositor quality.

workflowChanges: Verified the exact12 SHA, inspected the whole frame and every prescribed new scale/crop, then freshly compared 11/07 regions for claimed changes.
Checked the integrated grip and companion faces both natively and at 5x; distinguished a new tiny cosmetic mark from full-size blocking failures.
Reused actual identity/companion reference inspections and full skill readings honestly. No artwork, source, browser, publication or peer-review action was performed.
rulesNotApplicableWithReason: UI durations, springs, interruption and compositor rules cannot validate a silent raster still.
A generated dimensional image does not prove editable topology, physics or the existing 2D rig’s numeric reuse.
Magnified interpolation alone is not a full-frame defect; the Muse mark is recorded as a small cosmetic limit rather than inflated into an anatomy failure.
limits: Same bounded still-image judgment as the prior 8.3 review; no tested 3D model, hidden attachment topology, motion, sound or future night treatment.
Local resizes are not GitHub/browser/physical-device evidence. Human recognition, recall and emotional response remain untested.
Ready for owner review is this reviewer’s position only. Root still coordinates the independent full-team and pair stages.
No further art, extra agents or self-scheduled round was created.
independence: Saved this judgment before reading any peer12 finding or sending substantive peer12 findings. No new peer12 records were opened.
